guidance: So let me just conclude by saying that our operating target of 11,000 barrels of oil equivalent by middle of 2027 stays.
We expect this to improve as there will be gain in the momentum of the realization of the previous year B-80 inventory as well as the current stock of FSO.
capex: Page 3 of 22 Further, the capacities are coming in, and that is -- but we have also -- as you all know, 17% of Qatar LNG's capacity has been taken out in this war.
So Dirok field has 5 producing wells and our capacity, the potential there is to produce 1.2 million standard cubic meters on a gross basis, I mean, from all the wells.
risks: PY-1 will make gas, albeit that our coil tubing intervention, which we were planning to do before monsoon have got a bit delayed because the coil tubing units could not be mobilized.
So, there was a situation where we could have got into an arbitration or there was an arbitration, but we delayed, we Page 4 of 22 requested for deferment.
focus: As we enter the next phase of development program, an important focus for us is to conversion of the earnings into cash and that will be the top priority.

about: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited was incorporated in 1983, It is engaged in the exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas in India, both onshore and offshore. The company is India's first private E&P company and its assets are geographically spread across Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Assam and Arunachal Pradesh (both offshore and onshore).
